Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply: Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you. High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time. Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. title: Senior oil & gas regulatory & severance tax accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior oil & gas regulatory & severance tax accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote) Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore) Role Summary We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance. Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements. Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment. Technical Requirements ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4 HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Confira esta oportunidade para Technical project manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Fx trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Linux systems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux systems engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit 01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Médico pediatra (rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico pediatra (rqe) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental. Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25: O Grupo Capital: Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes. Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar. Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil. Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos. Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital: A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital. Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática. Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades: Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial: Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente. Modo de contratação: Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone. We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you! RESPONSIBILITIES • Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions. • Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices. • Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents. • Continually enhance the team's performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC. • Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise. • Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work. • Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders. WE ARE LOOKING FOR • At least 4 years of professional software development experience. • Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts. • Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms. • Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc. • Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.). • Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API's. • Strong working knowledge of relational databases. • Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis. • A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often. • An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner. • Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English. • Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams. NICE TO HAVE • Kubernetes or EKS. • Algolia. • Shopify. • Dynamo DB Who We Are? We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry's leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals. What's In It For You We offer 100% remote work Wellness/Fitness package Paid trainings and certifications 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us) Professional Conferences and Training Global Team Building Activities Access to co-working spaces worldwide Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists
We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build
The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring
3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements
Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Senior .net engineer (wfh)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .net engineer (wfh) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior. Net Engineer Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote Work Hours: US time zone Location: Brazil Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month About the Company We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration. Position Overview As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U. S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure Dev Ops. You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards. Key Responsibilities Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives. Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4. Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2 E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months. Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time. Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure Dev Ops. Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones. Qualifications Experience 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects. Technical Skills Proficiency in C# ASP. NET (. NET 8) for web applications and APIs. Experience with. NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (. NET 8), leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage. Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure Dev Ops). Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles. Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies. Soft Skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment. Preferred Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI). Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints. What We Offer Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects. Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation. Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success. How We Work Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews. Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify). Tool Stack: Azure Dev Ops, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies. Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. title: Full stack engineer (pleno) | node.js + react + php
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer (pleno) | node.js + react + php em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos? Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação: Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (Code Igniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração: Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (Java Script/Type Script), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados: Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (My SQL). Frontend: Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, Java Script (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança: Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e Dev Ops: Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience • Strong Python skills • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3 • Real production experience with ML on AWS • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data • Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content • A strong eye for correctness and data quality • Business level English • The ability to work independently in a small remote team • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions • 12 month B2 B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists
We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build
The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring
3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements
Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Médico pediatra (rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico pediatra (rqe) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging market trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience • Strong Python skills • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3 • Real production experience with ML on AWS • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data • Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content • A strong eye for correctness and data quality • Business level English • The ability to work independently in a small remote team • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions • 12 month B2 B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.
